name: Node.js Development Tools
description: Installs TypeScript toolchain, bundlers, linters, file watchers, and Bun runtime for Node.js development.

install.description: Comma-separated list of tool groups to install (e.g. 'typescript,bun'). When set, only the listed groups are installed. When empty (default), all groups are installed.

omit.description: Comma-separated list of tool groups to exclude (e.g. 'bun'). When set, the listed groups are skipped. Applied after 'install' filtering.
